paragraphs.en: CNN described how many Peruvians remember Robert Prevost: riding horseback to isolated Andean communities, handing out food during the Covid-19 pandemic and wading through floodwater in rubber boots. Father José Del Rosario said the then-bishop made the 700-kilometer trip from Chiclayo to the Diocese of Callao every two weeks in a simple pickup truck while serving as its apostolic administrator, and that the Church lost 11 priests and a bishop emeritus during the pandemic. Peru recorded more than 219,000 Covid deaths by Johns Hopkins University figures, and Bishop Prevost raised more than $380,000 with Caritas Chiclayo to buy two oxygen plants. Before leaving for Rome in 2023 he also appealed for help for more than 10,000 people hit by flooding from Cyclone Yaku, and a former Caritas director recalled him as "the person who put on his boots and waded into the water."
paragraphs.ko: CNN은 많은 페루인이 로버트 프레보스트를 어떻게 기억하는지 전했어요. 말을 타고 외딴 안데스 공동체를 찾았고, 코로나19 때 음식을 나눠 줬으며, 고무장화를 신고 홍수 물에 들어갔다는 거예요. 호세 델 로사리오 신부는 당시 주교가 카야오 교구 사도좌 관리자로서 두 주마다 소박한 픽업트럭으로 치클라요에서 700km를 달려왔고, 팬데믹 동안 사제 11명과 명예 주교 한 명을 잃었다고 말했어요. 존스홉킨스대 집계로 페루의 코로나19 사망자는 21만 9천 명이 넘었고, 프레보스트 주교는 카리타스 치클라요와 함께 38만 달러 넘게 모아 산소 공장 두 곳을 샀어요. 2023년 로마로 떠나기 전에는 사이클론 야쿠 홍수 피해자 1만 명 넘게를 돕자고 호소했어요. 전 카리타스 책임자는 그를 "장화를 신고 물에 들어간 사람"으로 기억했어요.

sents.en: CNN described how many Peruvians remember Robert Prevost: riding horseback to isolated Andean communities, handing out food during the Covid-19 pandemic and wading through floodwater in rubber boots.
sents.ko: CNN은 많은 페루인이 로버트 프레보스트를 어떻게 기억하는지 전했어요. 말을 타고 외딴 안데스 공동체를 찾았고, 코로나19 때 음식을 나눠 줬으며, 고무장화를 신고 홍수 물에 들어갔다는 거예요.

sents.en: Father José Del Rosario said the then-bishop made the 700-kilometer trip from Chiclayo to the Diocese of Callao every two weeks in a simple pickup truck while serving as its apostolic administrator, and that the Church lost 11 priests and a bishop emeritus during the pandemic.
sents.ko: 호세 델 로사리오 신부는 당시 주교가 카야오 교구 사도좌 관리자로서 두 주마다 소박한 픽업트럭으로 치클라요에서 700km를 달려왔고, 팬데믹 동안 사제 11명과 명예 주교 한 명을 잃었다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Peru recorded more than 219,000 Covid deaths by Johns Hopkins University figures, and Bishop Prevost raised more than $380,000 with Caritas Chiclayo to buy two oxygen plants.
sents.ko: 존스홉킨스대 집계로 페루의 코로나19 사망자는 21만 9천 명이 넘었고, 프레보스트 주교는 카리타스 치클라요와 함께 38만 달러 넘게 모아 산소 공장 두 곳을 샀어요.

sents.en: Before leaving for Rome in 2023 he also appealed for help for more than 10,000 people hit by flooding from Cyclone Yaku, and a former Caritas director recalled him as "the person who put on his boots and waded into the water."
sents.ko: 2023년 로마로 떠나기 전에는 사이클론 야쿠 홍수 피해자 1만 명 넘게를 돕자고 호소했어요. 전 카리타스 책임자는 그를 "장화를 신고 물에 들어간 사람"으로 기억했어요.

paragraphs.en: Beyond the warmth, Reuters framed the trip as a test of how directly Leo will engage Peruvian politics, noting that Fujimori took office this year after an election marred by fraud accusations and vote-counting delays. Her father, Alberto Fujimori, governed from 1990 to 2000, was later jailed for human rights abuses, was pardoned in 2017 and died in 2024, and Leo, then Bishop Prevost, criticized the pardon, saying the former president should seek forgiveness from victims. Martin Cassinelli of the Atlantic Council said there is "no other country where the pope is as attuned to the domestic politics," and that a reflection on the past could put him at odds with the current government. Fujimori campaigned on uncompromising security measures against rising crime, and she wrote on X ahead of the visit that the pope's arrival was "a message of hope for our country."
paragraphs.ko: 로이터는 따뜻한 분위기 너머로, 이번 방문이 레오 교황이 페루 정치에 얼마나 직접 뛰어들지 가늠하는 시험이라고 봤어요. 후지모리 대통령은 부정 의혹과 개표 지연으로 얼룩진 선거 끝에 올해 취임했어요. 그녀의 아버지 알베르토 후지모리는 1990~2000년 집권했고 인권 침해로 수감됐다가 2017년 사면됐으며 2024년 숨졌어요. 당시 프레보스트 주교였던 레오 교황은 사면을 비판하며 전 대통령이 피해자에게 직접 용서를 구해야 한다고 했어요. 애틀랜틱 카운슬의 마르틴 카시넬리는 "교황이 이만큼 국내 정치에 밝은 나라는 없다"며, 과거에 대한 성찰이 현 정부와 어긋날 수 있다고 말했어요. 후지모리 대통령은 늘어나는 범죄에 강경한 치안 대책을 공약했고, 방문에 앞서 X에 교황의 도착이 "우리나라에 주는 희망의 메시지"라고 적었어요.

paragraphs.en: Pew Research Center data show why the visit matters to the Church: in a spring 2026 survey of more than 6,100 adults in six Latin American countries, Catholics made up 67 percent of Peru, down from 76 percent in 2013-14. Some 60 percent of Peruvian Catholics say religion is very important in their lives, compared with 76 percent in Brazil and 68 percent in Colombia, while Mexico slipped from 81 percent Catholic to 71 percent. For Korean university students, the trip is a window into how a global institution tries to hold together faith, migration and inequality, themes that echo debates at home about shrinking rural towns and falling birth rates. The pope is due to leave Chiclayo on Sunday for Cusco and then a Peruvian stretch of the Amazon rainforest, with the tour ending on Monday before he returns to Rome.
paragraphs.ko: 퓨리서치센터 자료는 이번 방문이 교회에 왜 중요한지 보여 줘요. 2026년 봄 라틴아메리카 6개국 성인 6,100명 넘게를 조사했더니 페루 가톨릭 비율은 67%로 2013~14년의 76%에서 줄었어요. 페루 가톨릭 신자의 60%가 종교가 삶에서 매우 중요하다고 답했는데, 브라질은 76%, 콜롬비아는 68%예요. 멕시코는 가톨릭 비율이 81%에서 71%로 내려갔어요. 한국 대학생에게 이번 순방은 세계적 기관이 신앙, 이주, 불평등을 어떻게 아우르려 하는지 보여 줘요. 줄어드는 지방 소도시와 낮아지는 출산율을 둘러싼 국내 논쟁과도 닿아 있어요. 교황은 일요일 치클라요를 떠나 쿠스코로 간 뒤 페루 아마존 지역을 찾고, 월요일 순방을 마치고 로마로 돌아가요.

views.view: Leo's sermon in a poor Andean village tied emigration and falling birth rates to the threat facing rural communities.
Peruvians remember Prevost as a bishop who stood with them through the pandemic and floods, and greeted him with record crowds.
The homecoming is warm but will test how directly Leo wades into the politics of Fujimori's Peru.
Chiclayo welcomed him as its own, with about half a million at the open-air Mass and Leo calling it a joy to be back.
Church and civic leaders cast the visit as a gift of hope, while Cardinal Castillo said it comes amid violence and insecurity.
Catholics are 67% of Peru, down from 76% a decade ago, though 60% still say religion is very important to them.

why: The first Latin American tour of a Peruvian-American pope tests how the Church speaks to migration, poverty and insecurity in the region where it is losing ground.
lines.agree: Observers agree Leo has a deep personal bond with Peru and that his return drew some of the largest crowds of his papacy.
lines.split: Coverage differs on emphasis: pastoral warmth and homecoming in CNN and the BBC, political risk with the Fujimori government in Reuters.
lines.life: Students can read it as a case study in how rural depopulation, falling birth rates and internal migration, familiar in Korea, shape a country far away.
lines.next: He leaves Chiclayo on Sunday for Cusco and the Amazon, then ends the tour on Monday and returns to Rome.

talk.q: What can a religious leader's visit to a poor rural town teach us about migration and shrinking villages?
talk.qKo: 종교 지도자가 가난한 시골 마을을 찾는 일은 이주와 줄어드는 마을에 대해 무엇을 알려 주나요?
talk.answer: Pope Leo visited a town of about 6,000 people in a region where more than 40 percent live in poverty and many have left. His visit shows that shrinking villages are a human problem, not just a statistic. I think governments should listen to what small communities need, not only to the numbers.
talk.answerKo: 교황은 주민 약 6천 명, 주민의 40% 넘게가 빈곤층이고 많은 이가 떠난 지역의 마을을 찾았어요. 줄어드는 마을은 통계가 아니라 사람의 문제임을 보여 줘요. 정부가 숫자만이 아니라 작은 공동체가 필요로 하는 것에 귀 기울여야 한다고 생각해요.

issues.title: Top Scorer on Korea's Tax Accountant Exam Admits Cheating With Hidden Camera and AI, Turns Himself In
issues.gist: The top scorer on this year's tax accountant exam confessed on Nov. 15 that he used a miniature camera, a smartphone and generative AI to cheat in both rounds, and said he had surrendered to police. The case has jolted Seoul days before Thursday's national college entrance exam.
issues.gistKo: 올해 세무사 시험 수석 합격자가 소형 카메라, 스마트폰, 생성형 AI로 두 차례 시험에서 부정행위를 했다고 15일 고백하고 경찰에 자수했다고 밝혔어요. 목요일 수능을 코앞에 두고 나온 일이라 정부가 크게 긴장하고 있어요.
issues.easyKo: 세무사 시험 1등이 작은 카메라로 문제를 찍어 AI에게 보내 답을 받았다고 털어놨어요. 경찰이 수사하고 합격 효력도 멈추려 해요. 대통령실은 모든 국가시험의 AI 부정행위를 조사하기로 했어요.

paragraphs.en: The top scorer in this year's certified tax accountant exam admitted on Sunday that he had cheated in both rounds using a miniature camera, a smartphone and generative artificial intelligence, and said he had turned himself in to police. The man, identified by The Korea Times and The Korea Herald as Han Won-seok, 34, made the confession in a video posted on the YouTube channel of his lawyer, Lee Don-ho, appearing with his face partly covered by a mask. "I cheated by taking pictures of the questions with a miniature camera, sending them to AI, and checking the answers on a smartphone," he said, adding that he would hand over all remaining materials and devices to investigators. He also admitted using the same method in the first round of the certified public accountant exam in March, which he failed, and said he had submitted a written confession to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency.

paragraphs.en: Han's results had drawn attention because he answered 159 of the 160 multiple-choice questions correctly in the April first round, scoring 397.5 out of 400, with perfect marks in three of four subjects. Particular scrutiny centered on introductory tax law, a subject in which 16,856 test takers averaged just 30.18 points and about 74.21 percent scored below the 40-point minimum needed to avoid failing the subject. Candidates have 80 minutes to answer 80 questions across two subjects in each session, leaving roughly a minute per question, and Han later ranked first in the written second round, averaging 82.87 out of 100 against a passing cutoff of 49.75. The Korea Times reported that he scored 663 out of 800 in the second round in July, while Yonhap put his two accounting scores at 192 and 190 and his two tax law scores at 114 and 167.
paragraphs.ko: 한 씨의 성적은 4월 1차 시험에서 객관식 160문항 중 159문항을 맞혀 400점 만점에 397.5점을 받고 네 과목 중 세 과목에서 만점을 받아 주목을 끌었어요. 특히 세법학개론이 의심을 샀는데, 응시자 1만 6,856명의 평균이 30.18점에 불과했고 약 74.21%가 과락 기준인 40점에 못 미쳤어요. 응시자는 한 교시에 두 과목 80문항을 80분에 풀어야 해 문항당 1분 남짓이고, 한 씨는 이후 2차 필기에서도 평균 82.87점(합격선 49.75점)으로 1등을 했어요. 코리아타임스는 그가 7월 2차에서 800점 만점에 663점을 받았다고 전했고, 연합뉴스는 회계 두 과목 192점과 190점, 세법 두 과목 114점과 167점이라고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: Experts, including licensed tax accountants and tax lawyers, argued online that a near-perfect first-round score was close to impossible, and some suggested he might have used AI smart glasses, though his method turned out to be different. Han had earlier denied the allegations in a media interview, saying he was just an ordinary student and asking, "If AI glasses could answer every question correctly, why would anyone bother studying?" The suspicion grew after he published an account of his self-study preparation in the Tax and Finance Newspaper and posted his scores in an online community of tax accountant candidates. The Human Resources Development Service of Korea, which administers the exam, had first said it found no concrete evidence, and four proctors who supervised him in the two rounds reported noticing no suspicious behavior. The Korea Herald noted that two proctors were assigned to his room, and that he sat in the center of the second row for the first test and the center of the front row for the second.
paragraphs.ko: 공인 세무사와 세무 변호사 등 전문가들은 1차 만점에 가까운 점수가 거의 불가능하다고 온라인에서 주장했고, 일부는 AI 안경 사용을 의심했지만 실제 수법은 달랐어요. 한 씨는 앞서 언론 인터뷰에서 의혹을 부인하며 자신은 평범한 수험생이라고 했고 "AI 안경이 모든 문제를 맞힐 수 있다면 누가 공부하겠느냐"고 반문했어요. 그가 조세금융신문에 독학 준비 경험담을 싣고 세무사 수험생 온라인 커뮤니티에 성적을 올리면서 의혹이 커졌어요. 시험을 관리하는 한국산업인력공단은 처음에는 구체적 증거가 없다고 했고, 두 차례 시험에서 그를 감독한 감독관 네 명도 수상한 행동을 보지 못했다고 했어요. 코리아헤럴드는 그의 시험실에 감독관 두 명이 배치됐고 그가 1차에서는 둘째 줄 가운데, 2차에서는 맨 앞줄 가운데에 앉았다고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: Explaining his motives, Han said he had saved little at his previous job and that his own business failed after he quit, partly because of high costs linked to the war in Ukraine. Starting over in his mid-30s, he said, the fear of not knowing how long he would have to study left him extremely anxious, and he wanted to make his parents proud once more, even by cheating. He apologized "for the harm my wrongdoing has caused so many people" and promised to tell investigators everything, including how he prepared and practiced, to help prevent cheating in other qualification exams and the national college entrance exam. He declined to give further technical details, saying he did not want others to copy the method.
paragraphs.ko: 동기에 대해 한 씨는 이전 직장에서 돈을 많이 모으지 못했고 퇴사 후 차린 사업이 우크라이나 전쟁에 따른 높은 비용 등으로 잘 되지 않았다고 설명했어요. 30대 중반에 다시 시작하면서 얼마나 오래 공부해야 할지 몰라 극도로 불안했고, 부정행위를 해서라도 부모님을 다시 자랑스럽게 해 드리고 싶었다고 그는 말했어요. 그는 자신의 잘못이 많은 사람에게 끼친 피해를 사과했고, 준비와 연습 과정을 포함해 모든 것을 수사관에게 말해 다른 자격시험과 수능의 부정행위 방지를 돕겠다고 약속했어요. 그는 다른 사람이 따라 할까 봐 기술적 세부 내용은 밝히지 않았어요.

paragraphs.en: Police said they had received the statement and would investigate swiftly and thoroughly, while the Ministry of Finance and Economy said it would move quickly to suspend the validity of his pass certificate. The Korea Herald said the ministry would act through the Tax Accountant Qualification Deliberation Committee under the National Tax Service, and that under the Certified Tax Accountant Act a cheater has results voided and is barred from the exam for five years. The Human Resources Development Service apologized for failing to prevent the cheating as the exam administrator and said it would file a criminal complaint against him for obstruction of business. Yonhap added that criminal charges could follow depending on the police inquiry, and The Korea Times observed that the agency's initial findings raise doubts about whether the fraud would have surfaced had he posted lower scores or kept a lower profile. This year, 722 of 6,606 candidates who sat the second round passed, a pass rate of 10.92 percent, and the Korean Association of Certified Tax Accountants had asked authorities to investigate.
paragraphs.ko: 경찰은 자수서를 받았으며 신속하고 철저히 수사하겠다고 밝혔고, 재정경제부는 합격 확인서의 효력을 서둘러 정지하겠다고 밝혔어요. 코리아헤럴드는 재정경제부가 국세청 산하 세무사자격심의위원회를 통해 조치할 것이며, 세무사법상 부정행위자는 성적이 무효가 되고 처분일로부터 5년간 응시가 제한된다고 전했어요. 한국산업인력공단은 시험 관리 기관으로서 부정행위를 막지 못해 사과했고 업무방해 혐의로 그를 고발하겠다고 밝혔어요. 연합뉴스는 경찰 조사에 따라 형사 처벌로 이어질 수 있다고 덧붙였고, 코리아타임스는 공단의 초기 판단을 볼 때 그가 낮은 점수를 받았거나 조용히 지냈다면 드러났을지 의문이라고 지적했어요. 올해 2차 응시자 6,606명 중 722명이 합격해 합격률은 10.92%였고, 한국세무사회는 관계 당국에 조사를 요청한 상태였어요.

paragraphs.en: The case is the latest in a string of AI-assisted cheating incidents in South Korea, where two college applicants were caught using AI glasses during entrance exams at two Seoul universities in October. Education ministry data collected from schools between Oct. 27 and Nov. 3 also recorded four cases of AI glasses cheating at middle and high schools this year. Cheong Wa Dae said it was following developments "very seriously" and announced a full investigation of all suspected AI cheating in every national certification test after an emergency meeting chaired by policy chief Ha Joon-kyung. "The fairness of these tests is directly related to the people's trust, and any act of cheating must not be tolerated," Ha said, urging the education ministry to use every available tool, including thermal imaging cameras, at the college entrance exam. Prime Minister Han Seong-sook, who had vowed zero tolerance on Friday, is to convene vice ministers from the education, labor and interior ministries and other bodies on Monday to discuss further measures.

issues.gist: A bomb found at the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois, prompted a one-mile evacuation that lasted about 24 hours before police lifted it. The FBI is leading the investigation, and no arrests or injuries have been reported.

views.view: Bomb threats are frequent but rarely credible, and this one was confirmed real, with no other explosives found after a search.

talk.q: How should officials talk about a threat when they are not yet sure what the device is?
talk.qKo: 당국은 장치가 무엇인지 아직 확실하지 않을 때 위협을 어떻게 설명해야 할까요?
talk.answer: In Peoria, the mayor called it a bomb while the police chief only said it was a credible threat. I think officials should be clear about the danger people face, but careful about labels until the evidence is checked.
talk.answerKo: 피오리아에서 시장은 폭탄이라고 했지만 경찰서장은 신빙성 있는 위협이라고만 했어요. 저는 당국이 사람들이 처한 위험은 분명히 알리되 증거가 확인되기 전에는 명칭에 신중해야 한다고 생각해요.

paragraphs.en: A bomb discovered at a sprawling ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois, on Friday forced thousands of people out of their homes and workplaces before police lifted the evacuation order roughly 24 hours later. Police said they concluded at about 6:45 p.m. that a package at the BioUrja Renewables facility was a credible threat, and bomb technicians rendered the device safe at about 9:12 p.m. Investigators then combed the complex with plant employees for most of Saturday morning, and at about 1 p.m. police announced that no other devices had been found and residents could go home. No arrests have been announced, and no injuries were reported.
paragraphs.ko: 금요일 일리노이주 피오리아의 거대한 에탄올 공장에서 폭탄이 발견되어 수천 명이 집과 일터를 떠나야 했고, 경찰은 약 24시간 뒤 대피령을 해제했어요. 경찰은 오후 6시 45분쯤 바이오우르자 리뉴어블스 시설의 한 꾸러미가 신빙성 있는 위협이라고 판단했고, 폭발물 처리반이 오후 9시 12분쯤 그 장치를 안전하게 무력화했다고 밝혔어요. 수사관들은 이어 토요일 오전 대부분을 공장 직원들과 함께 단지를 샅샅이 뒤졌고, 오후 1시쯤 경찰은 다른 장치가 발견되지 않았으며 주민들이 집으로 돌아가도 된다고 발표했어요. 체포된 사람은 아직 발표되지 않았고 부상자도 보고되지 않았어요.

sents.en: Investigators then combed the complex with plant employees for most of Saturday morning, and at about 1 p.m. police announced that no other devices had been found and residents could go home.

paragraphs.en: Peoria Police Chief Brad Dixon said officers drew a one-mile blast radius, a distance he linked to the materials within the facility rather than to the size of the device itself. The zone took in parts of downtown, much of the South Side and the Warehouse District, and reached across the Illinois River to homes in East Peoria and several Caterpillar buildings. A CNN report carried by ABC7 Chicago put the number of residents and workers affected at more than 5,000, while the Guardian cited a figure of about 2,000 people. Officers went door to door overnight, and 60 to 80 people sheltered at Manual High School, where the Red Cross supplied cots and blankets, while no one used a second shelter in East Peoria. WCBU reported that the evacuation was not strictly mandatory, although officials urged everyone to stay out of the area, and most streets were closed, including several ramps on Interstate 74. The Coast Guard also closed a stretch of the Illinois River between mile markers 160 and 164 until 1 p.m., and Capt. Brandy Parker stressed the waterway's importance to regional and national commerce.
paragraphs.ko: 피오리아 경찰서장 브래드 딕슨은 경찰이 반경 1마일의 폭발 위험 구역을 정했다고 말했고, 이 거리는 장치의 크기가 아니라 시설 안의 물질을 근거로 했다고 설명했어요. 이 구역에는 시내 일부와 사우스사이드 대부분, 창고 지구가 들어갔고, 일리노이강 건너 이스트피오리아의 주택과 캐터필러 건물 몇 곳까지 닿았어요. ABC7 시카고가 실은 CNN 보도는 영향을 받은 주민과 근로자가 5천 명이 넘는다고 했고, 가디언은 약 2천 명이라는 수치를 인용했어요. 경찰관들은 밤새 집집마다 찾아다녔고, 60명에서 80명이 매뉴얼 고등학교에 머물렀는데 적십자가 간이침대와 담요를 제공했으며, 이스트피오리아의 두 번째 대피소는 아무도 이용하지 않았어요. WCBU는 대피가 엄밀한 의미의 의무는 아니었지만 당국이 모두에게 그 구역에서 벗어나 있으라고 촉구했고, 74번 주간 고속도로의 여러 진입로를 포함해 대부분의 도로가 막혔다고 전했어요. 해안경비대도 일리노이강의 160번에서 164번 마일 표지 사이 구간을 오후 1시까지 막았고, 브랜디 파커 대령은 이 수로가 지역과 전국 상거래에서 갖는 중요성을 강조했어요.

sents.en: Peoria Police Chief Brad Dixon said officers drew a one-mile blast radius, a distance he linked to the materials within the facility rather than to the size of the device itself.

paragraphs.en: Officials were far less aligned on what to call the object than on how dangerous it was, with Mayor Rita Ali telling reporters late Friday, “We know it’s a bomb.” Dixon, by contrast, would say only that it was a “credible threat” and that work to determine what the device contained was still under way. Ali later told WCBU that “bomb is my interpretation” and that law enforcement was right not to use the word until the contents had been examined. Dixon stressed that police were not treating the episode as a hoax, noting that threats of this kind are usually illegitimate but “this is not the case here.” Officials would not say whether the case was being handled as terrorism, though Dixon said the Department of Homeland Security was not involved and that the threat had been received electronically.
paragraphs.ko: 당국은 위험성에 대해서는 의견이 같았지만 그 물체를 무엇이라 부를지에서는 크게 갈렸고, 리타 알리 시장은 금요일 늦게 기자들에게 “우리는 이것이 폭탄이라는 것을 안다”고 말했어요. 반면 딕슨은 그것이 “신빙성 있는 위협”이었다는 것과 장치에 무엇이 들어 있었는지 확인하는 작업이 아직 진행 중이라는 것만 말하려 했어요. 알리는 이후 WCBU에 “폭탄이라는 말은 제 해석”이라고 말했고, 내용물이 조사되기 전에는 그 단어를 쓰지 않는 것이 법 집행기관으로서 옳다고 덧붙였어요. 딕슨은 경찰이 이번 일을 장난 신고로 보지 않는다고 강조하면서, 이런 협박은 대개 근거가 없지만 “이번에는 그렇지 않다”고 말했어요. 당국은 이 사건을 테러로 다루는지는 밝히지 않았지만, 딕슨은 국토안보부는 관여하지 않았고 협박이 전자적 방식으로 접수됐다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The FBI’s Springfield office said Saturday night that it was leading the investigation into what it called an explosive device, working with the ATF, the Illinois Secretary of State’s office, state police, the Peoria County Sheriff’s Office and local police and fire departments. Special Agent in Charge Ryan Presley vowed to work “tirelessly” to identify the person responsible and bring that person to justice, while the ATF’s Chris Amon said his agency was committed to finding whoever was behind the criminal act. A law enforcement source told ABC News that the investigation is criminal in nature, and the FBI asked anyone with information to call 911 or 1-800-CALL-FBI, or to submit a tip online, anonymously if preferred. Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias credited his office’s Hazardous Device Unit with rendering the device safe, and Gov. JB Pritzker said he had directed state police to coordinate with local authorities.
paragraphs.ko: FBI 스프링필드 지부는 토요일 밤, 자신들이 폭발물이라고 부른 장치에 대한 수사를 이끌고 있으며 ATF, 일리노이주 국무장관실, 주 경찰, 피오리아 카운티 보안관실, 지역 경찰과 소방서와 협력한다고 밝혔어요. 현장 책임자 라이언 프레슬리는 책임자를 찾아내 법의 심판대에 세우기 위해 “쉬지 않고” 일하겠다고 다짐했고, ATF의 크리스 에이먼은 범행 배후를 찾는 데 전념하겠다고 말했어요. 한 법 집행 소식통은 ABC 뉴스에 이 수사가 범죄 수사라고 말했고, FBI는 정보가 있는 사람은 911이나 1-800-CALL-FBI로 전화하거나 온라인으로 제보하되 원하면 익명으로 해도 된다고 요청했어요. 알렉시 지아눌리아스 일리노이주 국무장관은 자신의 사무실 소속 위험물 처리반이 장치를 안전하게 처리했다고 공을 돌렸고, JB 프리츠커 주지사는 주 경찰이 지역 당국과 협력하도록 지시했다고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: The plant, which police compared to 44 and a half football fields in size, makes ethanol, a highly flammable fuel and alcohol, and Mayor Ali said the highly combustible chemicals on site were what alarmed officials. Houston-based BioUrja bought the former Archer-Daniels-Midland complex in 2021, and the Guardian noted that the riverfront site was originally built as a whiskey distillery in the 1930s; the company did not immediately comment. Country singer Jon Pardi’s Friday concert at the Peoria Civic Center, where about 2,000 people were inside when the evacuations began, was canceled, and the venue paused Saturday events including a rescheduled Rivermen hockey game. Illinois Comic Con canceled its Saturday program but said Sunday was still on, while the Caterpillar Visitors Center, the Riverfront Museum and two libraries closed for the day. “This has never happened in my career,” Dixon said, conceding that the city could have done better but calling the response “a learning experience.”
paragraphs.ko: 경찰이 미식축구장 44개 반 크기에 비유한 이 공장은 불이 잘 붙는 연료이자 주류 원료인 에탄올을 만드는데, 알리 시장은 현장의 발화성 높은 화학물질이 당국을 긴장시킨 이유라고 말했어요. 휴스턴에 본사를 둔 바이오우르자는 2021년 옛 아처 대니얼스 미들랜드 단지를 사들였고, 가디언은 이 강변 부지가 원래 1930년대에 위스키 증류소로 지어졌다고 전했으며, 회사는 곧바로 입장을 내지 않았어요. 피오리아 시민회관에서 열릴 예정이던 컨트리 가수 존 파디의 금요일 공연은 대피가 시작될 때 안에 약 2천 명이 있었는데도 취소됐고, 이 공연장은 일정이 조정된 리버멘 하키 경기를 포함해 토요일 행사도 중단했어요. 일리노이 코믹콘은 토요일 일정을 취소했지만 일요일은 그대로 진행한다고 했고, 캐터필러 방문자 센터와 리버프런트 박물관, 도서관 두 곳은 하루 문을 닫았어요. 딕슨은 “제 경력에서 이런 일은 한 번도 없었다”고 말하며, 시가 더 잘할 수 있었음을 인정하면서도 이번 대응을 “배우는 경험”이라고 불렀어요.

paragraphs.en: The scare came on an already unsettled day, as a Federal Aviation Administration ground stop halted flights nationwide for about four hours, delaying or canceling more than 11,000, and a tanker struck a cruise ship docked in New Orleans. NPR added that hundreds of airline passengers in Europe had earlier in the week seen flights diverted or escorted by military aircraft after bomb threats that officials later declared malicious hoaxes. Because most bomb threats are never verified, a confirmed device is what set Peoria apart, and for students in Korea who study or travel in the United States it is a reminder of how quickly an alert can upend a city. The next things to watch are what kind of device it was, whether the FBI identifies a suspect or motive, and whether BioUrja explains how the plant was targeted.
paragraphs.ko: 이번 소동은 이미 어수선한 날에 벌어졌는데, 연방항공청의 운항 중단 조치로 전국 항공편이 약 4시간 멈춰 1만 1천 편 넘게 지연되거나 취소됐고, 뉴올리언스에서는 유조선이 정박한 유람선을 들이받았어요. issues.title: Netflix Sets Baltimore Opener for "KPop Demon Hunters" Golden World Tour, With 150-Plus Arena Shows Through 2028
issues.gist: Netflix said it will send its animated hit "KPop Demon Hunters" on a world arena tour opening June 5, 2027, in Baltimore, with more than 150 performances planned in nearly 50 cities. The company has so far announced 61 shows across North America and Europe, with other regions to follow.
issues.gistKo: 넷플릭스가 애니메이션 「케이팝 데몬 헌터스」의 월드 투어를 2027년 6월 5일 미국 볼티모어에서 시작한다고 발표했어요. 2028년까지 약 50개 도시에서 150회가 넘는 공연이 예정돼 있고, 지금까지 북미와 유럽 61회가 먼저 공개됐어요.
issues.easyKo: 넷플릭스의 인기 애니메이션 속 가상 걸그룹 헌트릭스가 실제 공연장에서 관객과 함께하는 투어를 열어요. 2027년 6월 볼티모어에서 시작해 전 세계를 돌 계획이고, 한국 일정은 읽은 기사에 나오지 않았어요.

paragraphs.en: Netflix announced on Saturday that "KPop Demon Hunters," the most-watched film in the streaming giant's history, will be taken on the road as the "KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour," a live arena concert series that opens June 5, 2027, in Baltimore. The company said the run will exceed 150 performances in nearly 50 cities across North America, Europe, the Asia-Pacific region and Latin America, stretching through 2027 and into 2028. So far, Netflix has detailed only 61 shows, all in North America and Europe and scheduled from June through October next year, while dates for the remaining regions are to be announced at a later time.
paragraphs.ko: 넷플릭스는 토요일, 자사 역대 최다 시청 영화인 「케이팝 데몬 헌터스」를 「골든 월드 투어」라는 아레나 공연 시리즈로 무대에 올리며 2027년 6월 5일 볼티모어에서 개막한다고 발표했어요. 회사는 이번 순회공연이 북미, 유럽, 아시아태평양, 중남미의 약 50개 도시에서 150회를 넘는 공연으로 2027년을 지나 2028년까지 이어진다고 밝혔어요. 지금까지 넷플릭스가 자세히 공개한 것은 내년 6월부터 10월까지 북미와 유럽에서 열리는 61회뿐이고, 나머지 지역의 일정은 나중에 발표될 예정이에요.

paragraphs.en: The tour is presented by Mastercard and produced by Netflix together with AEG Presents, and it is billed as an interactive production that fuses animation, advanced performance technology, live stunts and professional dancers. Audiences are meant to interact in real time with Rumi, Mira and Zoey, the members of the fictional girl group Huntrix, whose secret mission is to shield fans from supernatural threats. Their rivals, the Saja Boys, and the fan-favorite tiger character Derpy will also make animated appearances, and concertgoers will be invited to sing, dance and help Huntrix seal the Honmoon, the barrier at the center of the story. Creative direction falls to Amy Tinkham, a veteran director and show designer whose 25-year career spans live productions for Disney, Cirque du Soleil, Aerosmith, Paul McCartney and Mariah Carey. Her earlier credits include Disney's "Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour" and Cirque du Soleil's "Songblazers."
paragraphs.ko: 투어는 마스터카드가 후원하고 넷플릭스와 AEG 프레젠츠가 공동 제작하며, 애니메이션과 첨단 공연 기술, 라이브 스턴트, 전문 댄서를 결합한 참여형 공연으로 소개되고 있어요. 관객은 팬들을 초자연적 위협에서 지키는 비밀 임무를 가진 가상의 걸그룹 헌트릭스의 멤버 루미, 미라, 조이와 실시간으로 소통하게 돼요. 라이벌 사자 보이즈와 인기 캐릭터인 호랑이 더피도 애니메이션으로 등장하고, 관객은 노래하고 춤추며 이야기의 중심인 혼문을 봉인하는 헌트릭스를 돕게 돼요. 연출은 디즈니, 태양의 서커스, 에어로스미스, 폴 매카트니, 머라이어 캐리의 공연을 맡아 온 25년 경력의 베테랑 연출가 에이미 팅캠이 맡아요. 그의 이전 작품에는 디즈니의 「디센던츠/좀비스: 월즈 콜라이드 투어」와 태양의 서커스의 「송블레이저스」가 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Tickets go on sale to the general public on Friday, after a Mastercard presale on Wednesday and a "FOR THE FANS" presale on Thursday, according to The Korea Herald. A limited number of VIP packages will also be sold, bundling reserved seats with on-stage photo opportunities, limited-edition memorabilia, pre-show parties and custom merchandise. Marian Lee, Netflix's chief marketing officer, said in a statement that the franchise had grown from a "breakout hit into a generational phenomenon." She said the tour would carry the film's "Takedown" energy into arenas worldwide so that fans can take part in the story together.
paragraphs.ko: 코리아헤럴드에 따르면 입장권은 수요일 마스터카드 선판매와 목요일 「포 더 팬스」 선판매에 이어 금요일에 일반 판매가 시작돼요. 지정석에 무대 위 사진 촬영, 한정판 기념품, 공연 전 파티, 맞춤 상품을 묶은 VIP 패키지도 한정 수량으로 판매돼요. 넷플릭스 최고마케팅책임자 매리언 리는 성명에서 이 작품이 「돌풍을 일으킨 히트작에서 세대적 현상으로」 커졌다고 말했어요. 그는 이 투어가 영화의 「테이크다운」 에너지를 전 세계 아레나로 가져가, 팬들이 이야기에 함께 참여할 수 있게 한다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The animated musical, released June 20, 2025, has drawn more than 670 million views on Netflix, the company says, and it stayed on the platform's global Top 10 for 63 consecutive weeks. Its soundtrack has generated more than 15 billion streams worldwide, and the film won best animated feature at the 98th Academy Awards, the 31st Critics' Choice Awards and the 83rd Golden Globes. The Korea Herald added that its breakout song "Golden" became the first K-pop track to win both an Oscar and a Grammy. The franchise's momentum showed again at the Kids' Choice Awards, where "Golden," by EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami, took Favorite Song From a Movie, and BTS won Favorite Music Group or Duo, Deadline reported.
paragraphs.ko: 2025년 6월 20일 공개된 이 애니메이션 뮤지컬은 넷플릭스에 따르면 6억 7천만 회가 넘는 시청을 기록했고 글로벌 톱10에 63주 연속 머물렀어요. 사운드트랙은 전 세계에서 150억 회가 넘게 스트리밍됐고, 영화는 제98회 아카데미상, 제31회 크리틱스 초이스 어워즈, 제83회 골든글로브에서 장편 애니메이션상을 받았어요. 코리아헤럴드는 대표곡 「골든」이 K팝 곡으로는 처음으로 오스카상과 그래미상을 모두 받았다고 덧붙였어요. 이 작품의 기세는 키즈 초이스 어워즈에서도 이어졌어요. 데드라인에 따르면 이재, 오드리 누나, 레이 아미의 「골든」이 영화 부문 최고 노래상을, BTS가 최고 음악 그룹 또는 듀오상을 받았어요.

sents.ko: 코리아헤럴드는 대표곡 「골든」이 K팝 곡으로는 처음으로 오스카상과 그래미상을 모두 받았다고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: The franchise's momentum showed again at the Kids' Choice Awards, where "Golden," by EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami, took Favorite Song From a Movie, and BTS won Favorite Music Group or Duo, Deadline reported.
sents.ko: 이 작품의 기세는 키즈 초이스 어워즈에서도 이어졌어요. 데드라인에 따르면 이재, 오드리 누나, 레이 아미의 「골든」이 영화 부문 최고 노래상을, BTS가 최고 음악 그룹 또는 듀오상을 받았어요.

paragraphs.en: For Korean fans and students following the industry, the tour is a notable example of a Korean-flavored story being exported as a live, ticketed product through a global streaming platform. The articles I could read did not say whether any stops are planned in South Korea, and the Asia-Pacific dates have yet to be released. What to watch next is the announcement of those remaining dates and how quickly the first 61 North American and European shows sell out once general sales open on Friday.
paragraphs.ko: 업계를 지켜보는 한국 팬과 학생에게 이번 투어는 한국색 짙은 이야기가 글로벌 스트리밍 플랫폼을 통해 입장권이 팔리는 라이브 상품으로 수출되는 눈에 띄는 사례예요. 제가 읽은 기사에는 한국 공연 계획이 나오지 않았고, 아시아태평양 지역 일정도 아직 공개되지 않았어요. 다음으로 볼 것은 나머지 일정의 발표와, 금요일 일반 판매가 시작된 뒤 북미와 유럽의 첫 61회 공연이 얼마나 빨리 매진되는지예요.

issues.title: Binance Says It Has Covered $6.3 Billion Heist as U.S. Moves to Seize $1.2 Billion Tied to North Korea
issues.gist: Binance said it has covered every asset lost in an Oct. 29 cyberattack blamed on North Korea, committing more than $6.34 billion of its own funds. The U.S. Justice Department won court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of the loot and disrupted a related deepfake scheme.
issues.gistKo: 바이낸스는 북한 소행으로 지목된 10월 29일 해킹 피해를 63억 4천만 달러 넘는 자체 자금으로 모두 메웠다고 밝혔어요. 미국 법무부는 훔친 돈 가운데 12억 달러 넘게 압수·동결할 법원 승인을 받았고, 관련 딥페이크 사기 조직도 차단했어요.
issues.easyKo: 북한 해커가 거래소 바이낸스에서 약 63억 달러어치 암호화폐를 훔쳤어요. 바이낸스는 고객 손실을 자기 돈으로 다 메웠고, 미국은 훔친 돈 일부를 압수하려고 해요. 한국 서버 30대도 해커의 공격 목록에 올랐어요.

views.view: Binance has covered the losses and U.S. officials are tracing and freezing funds while North Korea denies involvement.
North Korean schemes have grown in scale and sophistication even as the U.S. seizes infrastructure and funds, an Arctic Wolf expert says.
The theft shows people and processes are the weakest links, and every organisation should tighten transaction limits, hiring checks and privileged devices.
Hackers tied to Lazarus put 30 South Korean servers on a target list, though a listing does not prove a breach.

heads.title: Binance says all asset losses from N. Korea-linked cyberattack covered
The Binance hack exploited familiar weaknesses – all organisations should learn from it
US disrupts North Korean campaign behind $400 million crypto theft
North Korea denies role in huge Binance crypto theft

why: The largest crypto theft on record puts a nation-state's cybercrime squarely in the sights of U.S. courts and prosecutors.
Binance's decision to cover all losses with its own money shows how an exchange can keep customer trust after a breach.
lines.agree: Investigators and security experts agree the attackers relied on deception and compromised insiders rather than on breaking the underlying cryptography.
lines.split: Washington and cybersecurity analysts blame North Korea's TraderTraitor group, while Pyongyang's Kim Yo-jong calls the accusation a grave political provocation.
lines.life: Students applying for crypto, developer or remote jobs should verify recruiters independently, since fake interviews and video calls are a main route into victims' computers.
lines.next: Watch for court rulings on final forfeiture of the $1.2 billion and for Binance to explain how its signing systems were breached.

talk.answer: The hackers used deception and a compromised laptop rather than breaking cryptography. I think companies should set limits on large transfers, and job-seekers should verify recruiters through independent contacts before taking any test or joining a video call.

paragraphs.en: Binance, the global cryptocurrency exchange, said on Thursday that it had finished making customers whole after an Oct. 29 cyberattack that U.S. investigators blame on North Korea, committing more than $6.34 billion of company money. The company said it drew on its Secure Asset Fund for Users, known as SAFU, as well as a futures insurance fund and its corporate treasury, while buying the affected tokens on the open market and through over-the-counter deals. It also pledged to replenish SAFU to roughly $1 billion so that the fund remains fully resourced as an emergency reserve for users. According to an analysis in The Conversation, the thieves took around $6.3 billion, most of it in under an hour, roughly four times the haul from the previous record theft, the February 2025 raid on the Bybit exchange.
paragraphs.ko: 글로벌 암호화폐 거래소 바이낸스는 목요일, 미국 수사당국이 북한 소행으로 지목한 10월 29일 사이버 공격의 피해를 모두 메웠다고 밝혔어요. 회사 자금 63억 4천만 달러 이상을 투입했다고 해요. 바이낸스는 사용자 보호 기금인 SAFU, 선물 보험 기금, 회사 금고에서 돈을 꺼내 쓰고, 피해를 입은 코인은 공개 시장과 장외 거래로 사들였다고 설명했어요. 또 SAFU를 약 10억 달러 수준으로 다시 채워, 사용자를 위한 비상 보호 자금으로 충분히 남겨 두겠다고 약속했어요. 더 컨버세이션의 분석에 따르면 해커들은 약 63억 달러를 훔쳤고 대부분은 한 시간도 안 되어 빠져나갔어요. 이는 직전 최대 사건인 2025년 2월 바이비트 거래소 탈취액의 약 네 배예요.

paragraphs.en: The same analysis, written by Bogdan Ksiezopolski of Kozminski University, said Binance found no evidence that its private keys had leaked, even though such keys are a known weak point. An early statement from the exchange instead pointed to a compromised laptop belonging to an engineer, which gave the attacker access to the internal system that processes withdrawal requests. Because blockchain records can be audited in full, investigators could trace the run-up: on Oct. 28 the attacking address received 0.3 ETH from Tornado Cash, a mixer that hides the origin of funds. A few hours before the theft, a malicious smart contract was deployed from that address, and at 20:20:59 UTC it sent a transaction carrying 50 signed authorisations meant to hand control of a Binance wallet to the contract. One of those authorisations was accepted by a Binance hot wallet, and the hackers then emptied 64 different tokens, worth about $2.5 billion, in a single transaction before draining other wallets in parallel. Valid Binance digital signatures were needed for those withdrawals, but how the attackers obtained them has not been explained, and the audit trail shows they had rehearsed several hours earlier.
paragraphs.ko: 코즈민스키 대학의 보그단 크시엥조폴스키가 쓴 이 분석은, 개인 키가 흔한 약점이긴 하지만 바이낸스가 키 유출의 증거는 찾지 못했다고 전했어요. 대신 거래소의 초기 성명은 한 엔지니어의 노트북이 해킹당했고, 그 때문에 공격자가 출금 요청을 처리하는 내부 시스템에 접근했다고 가리켰어요. 블록체인 기록은 모두 감사할 수 있어서 수사관들은 사전 움직임을 추적할 수 있었어요. 10월 28일 공격 주소는 자금 출처를 숨겨 주는 믹서 서비스인 토네이도 캐시에서 이더 0.3개를 받았어요. 도난 몇 시간 전 같은 주소에서 악성 스마트 계약이 배포됐고, 협정 세계시 20시 20분 59초에 지갑 통제권을 이 계약에 넘기려는 서명된 승인 50건이 담긴 거래가 전송됐어요. 그중 하나를 바이낸스의 핫월렛이 받아들였고, 해커들은 한 번의 거래로 약 25억 달러어치 토큰 64종을 비운 뒤 다른 지갑들도 동시에 털었어요. 이런 출금에는 바이낸스의 유효한 전자 서명이 필요했지만 공격자가 그것을 어떻게 얻었는지는 아직 설명되지 않았어요. 기록을 보면 이들은 몇 시간 전에 예행연습까지 했어요.

sents.en: Because blockchain records can be audited in full, investigators could trace the run-up: on Oct. 28 the attacking address received 0.3 ETH from Tornado Cash, a mixer that hides the origin of funds.
sents.ko: 블록체인 기록은 모두 감사할 수 있어서 수사관들은 사전 움직임을 추적할 수 있었어요. 10월 28일 공격 주소는 자금 출처를 숨겨 주는 믹서 서비스인 토네이도 캐시에서 이더 0.3개를 받았어요.

sents.en: A few hours before the theft, a malicious smart contract was deployed from that address, and at 20:20:59 UTC it sent a transaction carrying 50 signed authorisations meant to hand control of a Binance wallet to the contract.
sents.ko: 도난 몇 시간 전 같은 주소에서 악성 스마트 계약이 배포됐고, 협정 세계시 20시 20분 59초에 지갑 통제권을 이 계약에 넘기려는 서명된 승인 50건이 담긴 거래가 전송됐어요.

sents.en: One of those authorisations was accepted by a Binance hot wallet, and the hackers then emptied 64 different tokens, worth about $2.5 billion, in a single transaction before draining other wallets in parallel.
sents.ko: 그중 하나를 바이낸스의 핫월렛이 받아들였고, 해커들은 한 번의 거래로 약 25억 달러어치 토큰 64종을 비운 뒤 다른 지갑들도 동시에 털었어요.

sents.en: Valid Binance digital signatures were needed for those withdrawals, but how the attackers obtained them has not been explained, and the audit trail shows they had rehearsed several hours earlier.
sents.ko: 이런 출금에는 바이낸스의 유효한 전자 서명이 필요했지만 공격자가 그것을 어떻게 얻었는지는 아직 설명되지 않았어요. 기록을 보면 이들은 몇 시간 전에 예행연습까지 했어요.

paragraphs.en: The U.S. Justice Department said in a release issued Thursday that it had obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of the stolen cryptocurrency. That sum is part of more than $2.7 billion in assets frozen by American authorities and private-sector partners since the theft of over $6 billion in virtual assets. A. Tysen Duva, the assistant attorney general who leads the Criminal Division, said the funds were frozen before they got beyond law enforcement reach, halting about half of what he called a historic breach. The FBI attributes the heist to a North Korean military hacking group it calls TraderTraitor, and says the group keeps laundering the remaining assets through cryptocurrency bridges, mixers and exchanges while agents trace and try to recover them. The FBI, working with the Secret Service and the Internal Revenue Service, had issued a cyber alert the previous week that named North Korea and urged virtual asset service providers to block transactions tied to the laundering addresses. M. Scott Proctor, a senior national security official at the department, said Pyongyang's government bankrolls its regime and weapons program through crypto theft and that America would fight back.
paragraphs.ko: 미국 법무부는 목요일 낸 발표문에서 도난당한 암호화폐 가운데 12억 달러 이상을 압수하거나 동결할 수 있도록 법원의 승인을 받았다고 밝혔어요. 이 금액은 60억 달러가 넘는 가상자산 도난 이후 미국 당국과 민간 협력사가 동결한 27억 달러 이상의 일부예요. 형사국을 이끄는 A. 타이슨 두바 법무차관보는 자금이 수사기관의 손이 닿지 않는 곳으로 가기 전에 동결해, 역사적 해킹이라 부른 이번 사건의 약 절반을 막았다고 말했어요. FBI는 이번 도난을 자신들이 트레이더트레이터라 부르는 북한 군 소속 해킹 조직의 소행으로 보며, 이 조직이 남은 자산을 암호화폐 브리지, 믹서, 거래소로 계속 세탁하고 있다고 해요. 수사관들은 이를 추적하며 회수를 시도하고 있어요. FBI는 비밀경호국, 국세청과 함께 지난주 북한을 지목하는 사이버 경보를 내고, 가상자산 사업자들에게 세탁에 쓰인 주소와 연관된 거래를 막으라고 촉구했어요. 법무부의 M. 스콧 프록터 국가안보 담당 고위 관계자는 북한 정권이 암호화폐 절도로 체제와 무기 프로그램의 자금을 대고 있다며, 미국이 맞서 싸우겠다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Pyongyang has pushed back: Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong-un, rejected the FBI's findings earlier this month and called them a grave political provocation, and The Conversation noted that North Korea has denied involvement. The U.S. State Department answered by restating its concern that North Korea uses cybercrime to finance its weapons programs, describing the problem as global, affecting companies and jurisdictions around the world. Separately, the Justice Department announced it had disrupted a North Korean campaign known as FaceStealer, which used deepfake videos and fraudulent online meetings to steal more than $400 million in cryptocurrency over 18 months. According to CyberScoop, the FBI alert says hackers known as Sapphire Sleet, BlueNoroff, APT38 and Stardust Chollima hijack accounts on Telegram, LinkedIn, Slack and Discord, then invite targets to meetings hosted on typo-squatted imitations of Zoom and Microsoft Teams. The infrastructure the FBI seized held a library of more than 900 secretly recorded webcam videos, captured while victims waited for calls to begin and replayed to impersonate them in follow-on attacks. Because each compromise yields the next victim's video and contact list, the alert warned that the pool of targets grows exponentially, and it described a fake Teams meeting used this year to lure the maintainer of a major open-source JavaScript library.
paragraphs.ko: 북한은 반발했어요. 김정은 국무위원장의 영향력 있는 여동생 김여정은 이달 초 FBI의 결론을 거부하며 중대한 정치적 도발이라고 불렀고, 더 컨버세이션도 북한이 연루 사실을 부인했다고 전했어요. 미국 국무부는 북한이 사이버 범죄로 무기 개발 자금을 댄다는 우려를 되풀이하며, 이 문제가 전 세계 기업과 관할 지역에 피해를 주는 세계적 문제라고 설명했어요. 법무부는 이와 별개로 딥페이크 영상과 가짜 온라인 회의를 이용해 18개월 동안 4억 달러 넘는 암호화폐를 훔친 페이스스틸러라는 북한 해킹 작전을 차단했다고 발표했어요. 사이버스쿱에 따르면 FBI 경보는 사파이어 슬리트, 블루노로프, APT38, 스타더스트 촐리마로 알려진 해커들이 텔레그램, 링크드인, 슬랙, 디스코드 계정을 탈취한 뒤 줌과 마이크로소프트 팀즈를 흉내 낸 철자 위장 도메인의 회의에 피해자를 초대한다고 설명해요. FBI가 압수한 인프라에는 피해자가 통화를 기다리는 동안 몰래 녹화한 웹캠 영상 900개 이상이 있었고, 해커들은 이를 후속 공격에서 피해자 행세를 하는 데 틀어 줬어요. 침해가 일어날 때마다 다음 피해자의 영상과 연락처가 생기므로 대상이 기하급수적으로 늘어난다고 경보는 경고했어요. 올해 주요 오픈소스 자바스크립트 라이브러리 관리자를 가짜 팀즈 회의로 유인한 사례도 소개했어요.

paragraphs.en: Patrick Grandy, who runs the FBI's Los Angeles field office, said the scheme can deceive even the most experienced and security-conscious computer user because it exploits trust in video platforms and personal relationships. Bill Essayli, the U.S. attorney for the Central District of California, called cryptocurrency fertile ground for North Korea to defraud victims and fund its malign activities. Justin Moore of the security firm Arctic Wolf told CyberScoop that North Korean schemes have shown a significant evolution in scale and sophistication, even as law enforcement strikes back. The FBI credited Arctic Wolf, Jumpsec and the Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center with helping the investigation, and the department said the hackers increasingly target open-source maintainers to enable wider software supply-chain attacks.
paragraphs.ko: FBI 로스앤젤레스 지부를 이끄는 패트릭 그랜디는 이 수법이 화상 회의 플랫폼과 개인적 관계에 대한 신뢰를 이용하기 때문에 가장 경험 많고 보안에 신경 쓰는 사용자도 속일 수 있다고 말했어요. 캘리포니아 중부 연방지검의 빌 에사일리 검사장은 암호화폐가 북한이 피해자를 속이고 불순한 활동 자금을 마련하기에 비옥한 땅이 되었다고 말했어요. 보안업체 아크틱 울프의 저스틴 무어는 법 집행 당국이 반격하는 중에도 북한의 수법은 규모와 정교함 모두에서 크게 진화했다고 사이버스쿱에 말했어요. FBI는 아크틱 울프, 점프섹, 마이크로소프트 위협 인텔리전스 센터가 수사를 도왔다고 밝혔고, 법무부는 해커들이 더 넓은 소프트웨어 공급망 공격을 위해 오픈소스 관리자를 점점 더 노린다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Ksiezopolski argues that the Binance case is above all a story about people and processes, since cryptography itself was not compromised, and that banks, payment firms and hospitals share the same weaknesses. He notes that hardware security modules and multi-signature schemes cannot stop an attack launched from a compromised internal system, and recommends amount and time limits, approval through a second channel and automatic blocking of suspicious transfers within seconds. He also warns that North Korean operatives use fabricated identities, VPNs and deepfakes to pose as job candidates, so that video interviews and CVs no longer prove who someone is. He points to the 2024 raid on Japan's DMM Bitcoin, worth $308 million, which began when a fake LinkedIn recruiter sent a Ginco employee a coding test containing a malicious Python script. The article adds that Binance said it had been blocking North Korea-linked attempts involving fake recruiters for a week before the attack, though whether the two are related is not yet known.

paragraphs.en: The campaign reaches South Korea more directly than the headline figures suggest: on Sunday, the cybersecurity firm Cyfirma said Korean-speaking hackers linked to the Lazarus ecosystem had compiled a list of 216 servers in 10 countries, completed on Oct. 24. Thirty of the servers were in South Korea, and the list covered government agencies, banks, telecommunications companies and infrastructure providers, with the Asia-Pacific accounting for 148, North America 49 and the Middle East 19. Cyfirma assessed with high confidence that financial gain and espionage were the aims, but stressed that appearing on the list did not mean a server had been breached, and urged administrators to install patches and restart affected programs. The report followed a Seoul court ruling on Thursday that sentenced three members of a criminal ring to three to four years in prison for helping distribute illegal gambling sites built with North Korean hackers. Their ringleader, surnamed Kim, was sentenced in September to five years after earning about 23.5 billion won from 16 such sites made between 2022 and 2024, and sending more than 7 billion won to the hackers.

paragraphs.en: For Korean students, the episode matters on two fronts, because fake recruiters and deepfake interviews target exactly the kind of young job-seekers and developers who work in crypto and open-source communities. Investigators will next watch whether courts finalise the forfeiture of the $1.2 billion, how much of the remaining stolen money can be traced, and whether Binance publishes a fuller account of how its signing systems were breached.

issues.title: Judge Blocks Trump From Closing Historic DC Golf Course for Redesign
issues.gist: A federal judge temporarily barred the Trump administration from closing East Potomac Park and its public golf course, hours before a Sunday shutdown meant to start a 15-month overhaul. Judge Ana Reyes called the stated reasons pretextual and said the government had broken at least two federal laws.
issues.gistKo: 연방 판사가 일요일 폐쇄를 불과 몇 시간 앞두고 트럼프 행정부의 이스트 포토맥 공원과 공영 골프장 폐쇄를 일시 중단시켰어요. 아나 레예스 판사는 폐쇄 사유가 구실에 불과하고 정부가 연방법 두 개 이상을 어겼다고 밝혔어요.
issues.easyKo: 트럼프 대통령은 워싱턴의 오래된 공영 골프장을 15개월 동안 닫고 새로 만들려 했어요. 법원이 "일단 멈추라"고 명령해서 11월 28일까지는 공원을 닫을 수 없어요. 재판은 아직 계속돼요.

paragraphs.en: A federal judge in Washington on Saturday temporarily blocked the Trump administration from closing East Potomac Park and its historic public golf course, hours before a shutdown the president had scheduled for Sunday, Nov. 15. U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes issued a 30-page temporary restraining order that bars the government from shutting the park and the course during the daily hours in which they were open as of Nov. 14, 2026. The order runs through Nov. 28, 2026, or until the court says otherwise, and Reyes made clear it does not require the administration to actively manage golf operations at the site. She added that the government cannot use the absence of golf operations as a reason to exclude the public, although it remains free to carry out repairs so long as it gives the notice an earlier injunction requires. The ruling pauses Donald Trump's plan to remake the 106-year-old course, which sits about two miles south of the White House near the Jefferson Memorial, into a championship-level venue.
paragraphs.ko: 토요일 워싱턴의 연방 판사가 트럼프 행정부의 이스트 포토맥 공원과 역사 깊은 공영 골프장 폐쇄를 일시적으로 막았어요. 대통령이 일요일인 11월 15일로 잡아 둔 폐쇄를 몇 시간 앞둔 때였어요. 아나 레예스 연방지방법원 판사는 30쪽짜리 임시 제한 명령을 내렸어요. 이 명령은 2026년 11월 14일 기준 개방 시간대에 정부가 공원과 골프장을 닫지 못하게 해요. 명령은 2026년 11월 28일까지, 또는 법원이 달리 정할 때까지 유효해요. 레예스 판사는 정부가 그곳의 골프 운영을 적극적으로 관리하라고 강제하지는 않는다고 분명히 했어요. 그는 골프 운영이 없다는 점을 대중을 내보내는 이유로 쓸 수는 없다고 덧붙였어요. 다만 앞선 가처분이 요구하는 사전 통지만 하면 정부는 여전히 수리를 할 수 있어요. 이번 판결로 백악관에서 남쪽으로 약 2마일, 제퍼슨 기념관 근처에 있는 106년 된 골프장을 대회급 시설로 바꾸려던 도널드 트럼프의 계획이 일단 멈췄어요.

paragraphs.en: East Potomac Golf Links, which opened in the 1920s, is one of three public courses run by the National Park Service in the capital, and the surrounding park holds three courses totaling 36 holes. It also contains a miniature golf course and a paved loop popular with cyclists and runners, and thousands of runners in the Marine Corps Marathon passed through the park just last month. In an Oct. 18 social media post, Trump said the closure would last 15 months and turn the park's golf offerings into one of the "Best and Most Spectacular Golf Courses anywhere in the World." He has dismissed the current layout as "Trash Island," calling it old, broken and dilapidated, with dangerous, disease-infested trees and a collapsing and hazardous seawall. The new design by golf course architect Tom Fazio would take over the entire peninsula as a single 18-hole championship course that Trump says could host events such as the U.S. Open and the Ryder Cup. Court filings describe plans that would also eliminate the road around the peninsula and the recreation space at its southern end, while Trump insists the course would remain open to the public.

paragraphs.en: The legal fight began in February, when the DC Preservation League and two local golfers sued, arguing that the redevelopment violates various federal regulations and statutes. The plaintiffs, represented by the group Democracy Forward, say the plan would change the character of an accessible course and make it unaffordable, which the Republican president denies. The dispute escalated in October when the National Park Service told the judge it would remove trees and then cut down more than 500 of them over a single holiday weekend. The judge was told only about 15 hours before the work was set to begin, and officials later said the cutting was part of a 2019 plan that had recommended it. Reyes then barred further tree removal and ordered the government to give her three business days' notice of any other permanent change, saying the episode had cost the government "all of its credibility" in the case. Until then she had been reluctant for months to grant the plaintiffs' requests for work stoppages, and the tree-cutting ended that reluctance.
paragraphs.ko: 법정 다툼은 2월에 시작됐어요. 디씨 보존연맹과 지역 골퍼 두 명이 재개발이 여러 연방 규정과 법률을 어긴다며 소송을 냈어요. 원고들은 시민단체 데모크라시 포워드의 대리를 받고 있어요. 이들은 이 계획이 누구나 이용하던 코스의 성격을 바꾸고 비싸게 만들 것이라고 말하지만, 공화당 소속인 대통령은 이를 부인해요. 분쟁은 10월에 커졌어요. 국립공원관리청이 판사에게 나무를 베겠다고 알린 뒤 공휴일 연휴 한 번 사이에 500그루가 넘는 나무를 베어 냈어요. 판사는 작업 예정 시각을 약 15시간 앞두고서야 통보를 받았어요. 관계자들은 나중에 벌목이 2019년 계획에서 권고된 일이라고 설명했어요. 레예스 판사는 이후 추가 벌목을 금지하고, 다른 영구적 변경은 영업일 기준 사흘 전에 알리라고 명령했어요. 그는 이 일로 정부가 사건에서 "신뢰를 모두 잃었다"고 말했어요. 그때까지 그는 몇 달 동안 작업 중단을 요구하는 원고 측 신청을 받아들이는 데 소극적이었는데, 벌목이 그 망설임을 끝냈어요.

paragraphs.en: At a five-hour hearing on Friday, Reyes signaled that she was likely to order some kind of stoppage, and the only open question was how broad it would be. Justice Department lawyer Adam Gustafson argued that the whole park had to close because of a deteriorating seawall, safety hazards at the course and the expiring lease of its operator, the National Links Trust. Reyes replied that safety had not been part of the discussion for months, and she asked why the park had not been closed immediately if the situation was truly urgent. In her ruling she found the government's justifications to be "pretextual" and said it had violated at least two federal laws "to meet an arbitrary deadline." Trump's own posts weighed heavily, she wrote, because they indicate the plan is final and that the park service will close the park to carry it out. "The government proposes to close a historic park, daily enjoyed by Washingtonians of all stripes, indefinitely," Reyes wrote, adding that the government had not plausibly identified any harm from an order preserving the status quo.
paragraphs.ko: 금요일 5시간에 걸친 심문에서 레예스 판사는 어떤 형태로든 중단 명령을 내릴 가능성이 크다는 신호를 보냈어요. 남은 문제는 그 범위가 얼마나 넓은가였어요. 법무부 변호사 애덤 구스타프슨은 무너져 가는 방조벽, 골프장의 안전 위험, 운영자인 내셔널 링크스 트러스트의 임대 만료 때문에 공원 전체를 닫아야 한다고 주장했어요. 레예스 판사는 몇 달 동안 안전 문제는 논의 대상이 아니었다고 짚었어요. 상황이 정말 급했다면 왜 곧바로 닫지 않았느냐고도 물었어요. 판결문에서 그는 정부의 정당화 논리가 "구실"에 불과하다고 보았고, "임의로 정한 기한을 맞추려고" 연방법을 적어도 두 개 어겼다고 밝혔어요. 그는 트럼프 본인의 게시글이 크게 작용했다고 썼어요. 그 글들이 계획이 확정됐으며 공원관리청이 이를 실행하려고 공원을 닫을 것임을 보여 주기 때문이에요. 레예스 판사는 "정부는 온갖 부류의 워싱턴 시민이 매일 즐기는 역사적 공원을 무기한 닫겠다고 한다"고 썼어요. 현상을 유지하는 명령으로 정부가 입을 피해도 그럴듯하게 제시하지 못했다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: The park service has no plan to fix the seawall, and it is unclear how long the park would stay shut, even as a proposal sent to the Commission of Fine Arts last week put the new seawall's cost above $300 million. The same proposal estimated that the seawall work would take at least two and a half years, and the administration on Friday posted a notice seeking a contractor for 20,700 linear feet of shoreline and seawall infrastructure. Associate Attorney General Stanley Woodward told the court he would be shocked to learn of any contract with Fazio or affiliated entities finalizing the new course plans and construction. Gustafson said closing the park would not mean renovation starts at once, since the park service must still complete legal analyses under environmental and historic preservation laws and await reviews by two commissions. He also told the judge that the agency has "limited resources and discretion" and that "when the president talks, the agencies listen." The National Capital Planning Commission is set to consider the proposal for the new course at a Dec. 3 meeting.
paragraphs.ko: 공원관리청은 방조벽을 고칠 계획이 없고 공원이 얼마나 오래 닫힐지도 불분명해요. 그런데 지난주 미술위원회에 낸 제안서는 새 방조벽 비용을 3억 달러 이상으로 잡았어요. 같은 제안서는 방조벽 공사에 적어도 2년 6개월이 걸릴 것으로 내다봤어요. 정부는 금요일에 길이 2만 700피트의 해안선과 방조벽 시설 공사를 맡을 업체를 구하는 공고를 냈어요. 스탠리 우드워드 법무부 차관보는 법정에서 파지오나 관련 업체와 새 코스 계획과 공사를 확정하는 계약이 있다면 충격일 것이라고 말했어요. 구스타프슨 변호사는 공원을 닫는다고 해서 곧바로 개조가 시작되는 것은 아니라고 말했어요. 공원관리청이 환경법과 역사 보존법에 따른 법적 분석을 마쳐야 하고 두 위원회의 심의도 기다려야 하기 때문이에요. 그는 또 판사에게 해당 기관은 "자원과 재량이 제한돼 있고" "대통령이 말하면 기관들은 듣는다"고 말했어요. 국립수도계획위원회는 12월 3일 회의에서 새 골프장 제안을 심의할 예정이에요.

sents.ko: 그는 또 판사에게 해당 기관은 "자원과 재량이 제한돼 있고" "대통령이 말하면 기관들은 듣는다"고 말했어요.

sents.en: The National Capital Planning Commission is set to consider the proposal for the new course at a Dec. 3 meeting.
sents.ko: 국립수도계획위원회는 12월 3일 회의에서 새 골프장 제안을 심의할 예정이에요.

paragraphs.en: Catherine Carroll, a senior legal adviser at Democracy Forward, said the court had again intervened to prevent irreparable harm from what she called another of the president's vanity projects. A Justice Department spokesperson countered that the court acknowledged the park service can limit access where the public is at risk of harm, and that nothing in the order stops planning for a world-class course. Trump lashed out on social media even before the order, claiming Reyes does not want the government to fix the course quickly and inexpensively, and promising a 50% discount on rates for Washington-area residents. He has previously called the judge, who was appointed by President Joe Biden, a "lunatic," and the Justice Department has accused her of overstepping her authority and belittling government lawyers. The department demanded that she step aside over what it called her "egregious behavior," but she denied the recusal request and remains on the case. The Interior Department, the Justice Department and the White House did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the Guardian's inquiries.
paragraphs.ko: 데모크라시 포워드의 수석 법률 고문 캐서린 캐럴은 법원이 이번에도 회복할 수 없는 피해를 막아 주었다고 말했어요. 그는 이 사업을 대통령의 또 하나의 허영 사업이라고 불렀어요. 법무부 대변인은 법원이 대중이 위험에 처할 때 공원관리청이 접근을 제한할 수 있음을 인정했고, 명령이 세계적 수준 골프장 계획을 막지도 않는다고 반박했어요. 트럼프는 명령이 나오기 전에도 소셜미디어에서 레예스 판사가 골프장을 빠르고 싸게 고치는 것을 원치 않는다고 비난했어요. 워싱턴 지역 주민에게는 모든 요금을 50% 깎아 주겠다고도 약속했어요. 그는 전에도 조 바이든 대통령이 지명한 이 판사를 "미치광이"라고 불렀어요. 법무부는 그가 권한을 넘어섰고 정부 변호사들을 깎아내렸다고 비난했어요. 법무부는 그의 "터무니없는 행동"을 이유로 사건에서 물러나라고 요구했지만, 판사는 기피 신청을 기각했고 사건을 계속 맡고 있어요. 내무부와 법무부, 백악관은 가디언의 논평 요청에 즉시 답하지 않았어요.

paragraphs.en: Separately, Reyes has opened an inquiry into whether officials at the Interior Department, the Justice Department and the park service misrepresented facts to her or violated ethics rules. She intends to appoint Jessie Liu, a former U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, as special master to lead the probe, which the Justice Department opposes. The inquiry will examine whether government lawyers told acting park service director Jessica Bowron and Kevin Griess, the superintendent of National Mall and Memorial Parks, to omit or include certain information in sworn declarations. The ruling is the latest in a string of court challenges to Trump's efforts to remake the capital, including a White House ballroom, his name on the Kennedy Center and a massive memorial arch. Another judge recently ordered a 14-day delay on the arch work, shortly after a planning commission stacked with Trump appointees approved the project, and such orders have often arrived just hours before construction was to begin.
paragraphs.ko: 이와 별개로 레예스 판사는 내무부와 법무부, 공원관리청 관계자들이 자신에게 사실을 왜곡했거나 윤리 규정을 어겼는지 조사에 착수했어요. 그는 전 워싱턴 DC 연방검사 제시 리우를 특별 조사관으로 임명해 조사를 맡길 생각이에요. 법무부는 이에 반대해요. 조사는 정부 변호사들이 국립공원관리청 직무대행 국장 제시카 보우런과 내셔널 몰 및 기념공원 관리소장 케빈 그리스에게 선서 진술서에 특정 정보를 빼거나 넣으라고 했는지도 살펴요. 이번 판결은 백악관 연회장, 케네디 센터에 그의 이름을 붙이는 일, 대형 기념 아치 등 트럼프가 수도를 개조하려는 시도에 제기된 일련의 소송 가운데 가장 최근 사례예요. 다른 판사는 최근 트럼프가 임명한 인사들이 다수인 계획위원회가 아치 사업을 승인한 직후 공사를 14일 미루라고 명령했어요. 이런 명령은 공사 시작 몇 시간 전에 나오는 경우가 많았어요.

paragraphs.en: For students in Korea, the case is a vivid example of how courts can check a president's decisions about public land by demanding that real reasons and legal procedures come before a deadline. The restraining order is temporary, so the fight over East Potomac continues, with the order expiring on Nov. 28 unless the court extends it and the planning commission meeting set for Dec. 3. Watchers will also follow the ethics inquiry led by Liu and whether the Justice Department succeeds in blocking it or in removing Reyes from the case.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 학생들에게 이 사건은 법원이 공공 토지에 대한 대통령의 결정에 기한보다 실제 이유와 법적 절차가 먼저라고 요구하며 견제할 수 있는 생생한 사례예요. 이 제한 명령은 임시 조치여서 이스트 포토맥을 둘러싼 다툼은 이어져요. 법원이 연장하지 않으면 명령은 11월 28일에 끝나고, 12월 3일에는 계획위원회 회의가 열려요. 지켜볼 점은 리우가 이끄는 윤리 조사와, 법무부가 이를 막거나 레예스 판사를 사건에서 빼는 데 성공하느냐예요.

views.view: The judge found the closure rationale pretextual and the government in breach of at least two federal laws, though it need not actively manage the course.
The ruling is the latest judicial pushback on Trump's redesign of Washington through big construction projects, many of them challenged in court.
Reyes said the government reverse-engineers justifications for closing the park while insisting it will close it to follow the president's directive.
Trump's own social media posts on the Nov. 15 closure weighed heavily in the decision and presented a problem for the government's case.

heads.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation
US judge blocks Trump’s plan to renovate historic DC golf course
Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
Federal judge blocks Trump from closing historic D.C. golf course, for now

why: A court has halted a presidential construction plan on public land hours before it began, testing how far an administration can go when a legal challenge is pending.
The judge also opened an ethics inquiry into whether government lawyers misled her.
lines.agree: Everyone agrees the park service remains free to make repairs with notice, and that the order is temporary and the lawsuit continues.
lines.split: The plaintiffs call the plan a vanity project that would destroy a treasured park, while the Justice Department says planning for a world-class course may continue.
lines.life: For Korean students, it shows how courts and public hearings can slow even a president's pet project, a useful example for civics and law essays.
lines.next: Watch for the Nov. 28 expiry of the order, the Dec. 3 planning commission meeting and the ethics inquiry led by Jessie Liu.

talk.q: Should a leader be able to redesign a public park without a lengthy legal and public review?

talk.answer: I think reviews matter because the park is used daily by ordinary residents. The judge said the government's reasons were pretextual and that it had broken federal law to meet an arbitrary deadline. Fast projects can be exciting, but I believe public land needs transparent procedures first.

issues.title: Harrison Submits Returning Nunes to Retain UFC Title at Madison Square Garden
issues.gist: Kayla Harrison retained her UFC women's bantamweight title by submitting the returning Amanda Nunes in the fourth round of UFC 334 in New York. In the main event, Ciryl Gane held off Josh Hokit on a unanimous decision to keep the heavyweight belt.
issues.gistKo: 케일라 해리슨이 뉴욕 UFC 334에서 복귀한 아만다 누네스를 4라운드에 서브미션으로 꺾고 여자 밴텀급 타이틀을 지켰어요. 메인 이벤트에서는 시릴 가누가 조시 호킷을 판정으로 이기고 헤비급 벨트를 지켰어요.
issues.easyKo: 격투기 UFC에서 케일라 해리슨 선수가 3년 반 만에 돌아온 전설 아만다 누네스 선수를 4라운드에 기술로 항복시켜 챔피언 자리를 지켰어요. 메인 경기에서는 시릴 가누 선수가 판정으로 이겼어요.

paragraphs.en: Kayla Harrison retained her UFC women's bantamweight title on Saturday night at Madison Square Garden in New York, forcing Amanda Nunes to tap out to a rear-naked choke early in the fourth round of the UFC 334 co-main event. The 36-year-old American, a two-time Olympic judo gold medalist, thereby spoiled the comeback of the 38-year-old Brazilian, who is widely regarded as the greatest female fighter in the sport's history and had been retired for roughly three and a half years. Harrison, who improved to 20-1 as a professional, told the crowd she was still in shock, and described the night as surreal, adding that she felt grateful and humbled. In the main event, Ciryl Gane of France kept his heavyweight title by beating the American Josh Hokit on a unanimous decision, taking all three scorecards 48-47 after five bruising rounds.

paragraphs.en: Nunes, whose record fell to 23-6, began the stronger of the two on the feet, stinging Harrison with straight rights, bloodying her lip and putting the champion on the retreat. But the Brazilian kept steering the contest toward grappling, a tactic that played into Harrison's hands, and the champion landed takedowns in each of the first two rounds, spending long stretches on top in a dominant scarf-hold position. On the ground Harrison also opened a cut on Nunes with a heavy elbow and right hand, after hauling her down with a powerful hip toss. Nunes scored a takedown of her own in the third round, yet Harrison reversed position and regained control almost at once. The finish arrived at 1 minute, 29 seconds of the fourth round, when Harrison won another scramble, grabbed Nunes by the leg, tripped her to the canvas, took her back and sank in the choke as the stunned Garden crowd watched.
paragraphs.ko: 전적이 23승 6패가 된 누네스는 서서 싸울 때 먼저 우위를 잡아 곧은 오른손으로 해리슨을 흔들고 입술에서 피가 나게 했으며, 챔피언을 뒤로 물러서게 했어요. 그러나 브라질 선수는 계속 그라운드 싸움으로 흐름을 끌고 갔고, 이는 해리슨에게 유리한 전술이어서 챔피언은 1, 2라운드마다 테이크다운을 성공시키며 가로누르기 자세로 위에서 오래 우세를 지켰어요. 해리슨은 강한 허리 던지기로 누네스를 눕힌 뒤 바닥에서 묵직한 팔꿈치와 오른손 공격으로 상처를 내기도 했어요. 누네스가 3라운드에 직접 테이크다운을 성공시켰지만 해리슨은 곧바로 위치를 뒤집어 다시 주도권을 잡았어요. 마무리는 4라운드 1분 29초에 왔는데, 해리슨이 또 한 번의 몸싸움에서 이겨 누네스의 다리를 잡아 넘어뜨리고 등을 점령한 뒤 초크를 걸었고 놀란 관중이 그 장면을 지켜봤어요.

paragraphs.en: Nunes left the UFC in 2023 as the only woman to hold titles in two weight classes at the same time, and the only fighter, male or female, to defend both belts successfully. She won the bantamweight belt in 2016 and the featherweight belt in 2018, lost the bantamweight crown to Julianna Pena in 2021 after five defenses, and regained it in a rematch seven months later. After one more defense she retired in June 2023 following a decision win over Irene Aldana, citing burnout and a wish to spend more time with her wife and their two young daughters. Along the way she beat Ronda Rousey, Cris Cyborg and Valentina Shevchenko, but it was the prospect of facing Harrison that coaxed her out of retirement. Harrison won judo gold in 2012 and 2016, became a two-time PFL lightweight champion, and took the UFC belt in June 2025 by submitting Pena in only her third fight with the promotion. The two are friends and former teammates at American Top Team in South Florida, a gym Nunes left in 2022, though coaches there say they trained together very little. The bout had been booked for January, but Harrison withdrew to undergo spinal fusion surgery for herniated discs in her neck, leaving her without a fight since June 2025.
paragraphs.ko: 누네스는 2023년 UFC를 떠날 때, 두 체급 타이틀을 동시에 보유한 유일한 여성이자 남녀를 통틀어 두 벨트를 모두 방어에 성공한 유일한 선수였어요. 그는 2016년 밴텀급, 2018년 페더급 벨트를 따냈고, 2021년 다섯 번 방어한 뒤 줄리아나 페냐에게 밴텀급 왕좌를 내줬다가 7개월 뒤 재대결에서 되찾았어요. 한 번 더 방어한 뒤 2023년 6월 아이린 알다나에게 판정승을 거두고 은퇴했는데, 번아웃과 아내, 어린 두 딸과 더 많은 시간을 보내고 싶다는 바람을 이유로 들었어요. 그 사이 론다 로우지, 크리스 사이보그, 발렌티나 셰프첸코를 꺾었지만, 그를 은퇴에서 불러낸 것은 해리슨과의 대결이라는 전망이었어요. 해리슨은 2012년과 2016년에 유도 금메달을 땄고 PFL 라이트급 챔피언에 두 번 올랐으며, 2025년 6월 UFC에서 세 번째 경기만에 페냐를 서브미션으로 꺾고 벨트를 차지했어요. 두 사람은 플로리다 남부의 아메리칸 탑 팀 체육관에서 함께 훈련한 친구이자 옛 동료로, 누네스는 2022년에 그곳을 떠났지만 코치들은 둘이 함께 훈련한 적은 거의 없다고 말해요. 이 경기는 1월로 잡혀 있었지만 해리슨이 목 디스크 때문에 척추 유합 수술을 받으려고 빠졌고, 그래서 2025년 6월 이후 경기를 치르지 못했어요.

paragraphs.en: ESPN's Jeff Wagenheim wrote that Nunes had the experience and the striking to make it a hard night for Harrison, but played into the champion's greatest strength, a costly tactical mistake that ultimately decided the fight. He said the only surprise was how willing Nunes was to leave the striking, where she held a clear edge, and she showed no real sign that her physical skills had faded after 3½ years away. In his view Nunes handed future challengers a blueprint of what not to do, since Harrison's striking is rudimentary at best and the next opponent will have to find a way to stay on their feet. The Guardian's account struck a similar note, saying Nunes may be considered the greatest fighter in the sport's history while Harrison staked her claim as the best right now. Harrison's biggest struggle remains the weight cut, since she competed mostly at 155 pounds in the PFL and must now make the 135-pound bantamweight limit. "Every time I make weight, I say never again," she said, adding that she has "a lot of decisions to make" and expects to need time to heal injuries from the fight. Nunes walked out of the octagon on her own, while a weakened Harrison needed help getting back to the locker room with the belt still around her waist.

sents.ko: 누네스는 스스로 옥타곤을 걸어 나갔지만 기력이 빠진 해리슨은 벨트를 허리에 찬 채 라커룸으로 돌아가는 데 도움이 필요했어요.

paragraphs.en: Gane was making the first defense of the heavyweight title since being promoted to undisputed champion in September, after Tom Aspinall vacated the belt. The 36-year-old, who beat Alex Pereira at the White House card in June to claim the interim title, was pushed hard by Hokit, a 28-year-old with a 10-1 record who was fighting for a belt after only about a year in the UFC. Hokit swarmed him with takedown attempts and punches from the opening bell, but Gane countered off the back foot, used his jab well and took control as the challenger tired in the later rounds. The two set a record with 383 significant strikes in a UFC heavyweight bout, and both ended bloodied, Hokit above the left eye and Gane from the mouth. The pro-Hokit crowd howled in disbelief at the scorecards, and Hokit, wearing an American flag bandana, said he would rejoice in his suffering and become champion one day. ESPN's Brett Okamoto argued that Gane, who has been booed for years after losses to Jon Jones and Francis Ngannou and an eye-poke controversy with Aspinall, deserves a more celebratory setting, perhaps a fight in his home country of France. BBC Sport noted that the win could set up a rematch with Aspinall, should the Briton recover fully from an eye injury.
paragraphs.ko: 가누는 9월 톰 애스피널이 벨트를 반납하면서 정식 챔피언으로 올라선 뒤 처음으로 헤비급 타이틀을 방어했어요. 6월 백악관 대회에서 알렉스 페레이라를 꺾고 잠정 타이틀을 차지한 36세의 가누는, UFC에 들어온 지 1년 남짓 만에 타이틀전에 나선 10승 1패의 28세 호킷에게 거세게 밀렸어요. 호킷은 첫 공이 울리자마자 테이크다운 시도와 펀치로 몰아붙였지만, 가누는 뒤로 물러서며 받아치고 잽을 잘 활용했으며 후반 라운드에서 도전자가 지치자 흐름을 가져갔어요. 두 선수는 UFC 헤비급 경기 최다인 383회의 유효타를 기록했고, 호킷은 왼쪽 눈 위에서, 가누는 입에서 피를 흘리며 경기를 마쳤어요. 호킷을 응원하던 관중은 채점 결과에 믿기지 않는다는 듯 야유를 보냈고, 성조기 두건을 두른 호킷은 고통 속에서도 기뻐하겠다며 언젠가 챔피언이 되겠다고 말했어요. ESPN의 브렛 오카모토는 존 존스와 프란시스 은가누에게 진 뒤, 그리고 애스피널과의 눈 찌르기 논란 이후 수년째 야유를 받아 온 가누가 더 축하받는 무대, 이를테면 고향 프랑스에서의 경기를 누릴 자격이 있다고 주장했어요. BBC 스포츠는 이번 승리가 애스피널과의 재대결로 이어질 수 있다고 전했는데, 영국 선수가 눈 부상에서 완전히 회복하는 경우에 한해서예요.

paragraphs.en: The undercard carried its own farewell, as 43-year-old Stephen Thompson ended a 16-year career by stopping Charles Radtke in the third round with a spinning wheel kick. Thompson, a former welterweight title challenger who finished with 18 wins in 28 professional bouts, laid his gloves on the mat, and the UFC played a video tribute. He said he had told himself he would not cry, and that the sport would not exist without his fans. Elsewhere on the card, Britain's Chris Duncan beat the American Drew Dober by unanimous decision for his seventh win in nine UFC fights. UFC chief Dana White occupied his usual cageside seat, while President Donald Trump, who has attended UFC events at the Garden before, was absent after bringing the promotion to the White House lawn this summer. The card also marked a decade since mixed martial arts was legalized in New York, with Conor McGregor's lightweight title win at the Garden ten years ago remembered as the debut night. What to watch next is whether Harrison, who is noncommittal about her future, keeps fighting at 135 pounds, and whether Gane meets Aspinall again once the Briton's eye heals.
paragraphs.ko: 언더카드에도 작별이 있었는데, 43세의 스티븐 톰슨이 3라운드에 돌려차기로 찰스 래드키를 쓰러뜨리며 16년의 선수 생활을 마무리했어요. 웰터급 타이틀에 도전했던 톰슨은 프로 28경기에서 18승으로 은퇴하며 글러브를 매트 위에 내려놓았고, UFC는 헌정 영상을 틀었어요. 그는 울지 않겠다고 다짐했었다고 말했고, 팬들이 없었다면 이 종목도 없었을 것이라고 했어요. 같은 대회의 다른 경기에서는 영국의 크리스 던컨이 미국의 드루 도버를 판정으로 꺾어 UFC 9경기에서 7승째를 올렸어요. UFC 대표 데이나 화이트는 늘 앉던 케이지 옆 자리를 지켰고, 이전에 이곳 대회를 찾은 적이 있는 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 올여름 UFC를 백악관 잔디밭에 불러들인 뒤 이번에는 오지 않았어요. 이번 대회는 뉴욕에서 종합격투기가 합법화된 지 10년이 되는 때이기도 했고, 10년 전 가든에서 코너 맥그리거가 라이트급 타이틀을 따낸 경기가 그 첫 대회로 회자됐어요. 앞으로 눈여겨볼 점은 자신의 앞날에 대해 말을 아낀 해리슨이 135파운드에서 계속 싸울지, 그리고 영국 선수의 눈이 낫는 대로 가누가 애스피널과 다시 맞붙을지예요.

views.view: Nunes played into Harrison's greatest strength by chasing grappling exchanges, a costly tactical mistake that decided the fight.
Nunes may be considered the greatest fighter in history, but Harrison staked her claim as the best right now.
The win was Harrison's 20th in 21 fights, cementing her status as one of the best combat sports athletes of all time.
Nunes looked crisp early but could not shake off the rust of her long absence, and Harrison's grappling gradually took over.
Gane deserves a celebratory setting such as a home fight in France after years of being booed.

why: A champion beat an all-time great returning from a three-year retirement, reshaping the debate over who is the best female fighter in MMA.
lines.agree: Outlets agree that Harrison's grappling decided the fight and that Nunes' legacy remains secure.
lines.split: Some fans and writers felt Hokit was robbed of the decision against Gane, while others saw Gane as a deserving winner.
lines.life: The story shows how a comeback, an injury recovery and a brutal weight cut shape an athlete's choices, a theme familiar to any student balancing ambition and limits.
lines.next: Watch whether Harrison keeps fighting at 135 pounds and whether Gane faces Tom Aspinall once his eye heals.

issues.title: Tanker Slams Into Docked Cruise Ship in New Orleans; All Aboard Survive in 'Miracle on the Mississippi'
issues.gist: A tanker, the Atlantic Asphalt, struck the docked paddlewheel cruise ship American Heritage on the Mississippi in New Orleans, toppling it and sending passengers into the river. Everyone was accounted for, and the port has since sued the tanker's owner and manager for more than $1 million.
issues.gistKo: 유조선 애틀랜틱 애스팰트가 뉴올리언스 미시시피강에 정박해 있던 유람선 아메리칸 헤리티지를 들이받아 배가 뒤집혔어요. 승객은 모두 확인됐고, 항만 당국은 선주와 관리사를 상대로 100만 달러 넘는 소송을 냈어요.
issues.easyKo: 큰 유조선이 강가에 서 있던 유람선을 들이받아 유람선이 옆으로 누웠어요. 사람들이 물에 빠졌지만 모두 구조돼 사망자가 없었어요. 항만은 유조선 회사를 고소했고, 원인은 아직 조사 중이에요.

paragraphs.en: A tanker named the Atlantic Asphalt crashed into the docked paddlewheel cruise ship American Heritage on the Mississippi River in New Orleans at about 12:30 p.m. on Friday. The much smaller riverboat had tied up roughly two hours earlier at the port's Thalia Street terminal, and its passengers were disembarking when the collision occurred. Mayor Helena Moreno said the tanker had lost control, after which the cruise ship began to sink, toppled over and flipped, throwing people into the water. Videos posted online showed passengers in life jackets floating in the river or standing near the railing as the vessel listed farther into the water. One witness, Jamie Holford, told CBS News the scene looked like something off the Titanic and that the crunching steel sounded like a war movie.

sents.en: A tanker named the Atlantic Asphalt crashed into the docked paddlewheel cruise ship American Heritage on the Mississippi River in New Orleans at about 12:30 p.m. on Friday.
sents.ko: 미시시피강 뉴올리언스에서 금요일 낮 12시 30분쯤 유조선 애틀랜틱 애스팰트가 정박 중이던 외륜 유람선 아메리칸 헤리티지를 들이받았어요.

sents.en: The much smaller riverboat had tied up roughly two hours earlier at the port's Thalia Street terminal, and its passengers were disembarking when the collision occurred.

sents.en: Mayor Helena Moreno said the tanker had lost control, after which the cruise ship began to sink, toppled over and flipped, throwing people into the water.

paragraphs.en: Port NOLA Harbor Police, the New Orleans Fire and Police Departments and the U.S. Coast Guard led the rescue, joined by private vessels on the river that responded as volunteers. Moreno said rescuers pulled about 100 people from the water, and she hailed the outcome as a "miracle on the Mississippi," crediting local, state and federal first responders. Thirty-two passengers were taken to hospitals with non-critical injuries, two Harbor Police officers were also hospitalized in good condition, and no one aboard the tanker was hurt. By Saturday afternoon eight people remained in hospital, two of them in serious condition, while every person aboard both vessels had been accounted for and no deaths were reported. Headcounts varied by source: the mayor cited 191 passengers and crew, the port authority put passengers at about 129 plus crew, and the Guardian reported 197 passengers. The American Heritage, built in 2015 and operated by American Cruise Lines, is five stories tall, can hold up to 150 passengers and was finishing an eight-day cruise through Louisiana and Mississippi.
paragraphs.ko: 뉴올리언스 항만 경찰, 시 소방서와 경찰, 미 해안경비대가 구조를 이끌었고, 강에 있던 민간 선박들이 자원봉사자로 가세했어요. 모레노 시장은 구조대가 물에서 약 100명을 끌어냈다고 밝히고, 이 결과를 지방·주·연방 구조대의 공으로 돌리며 "미시시피의 기적"이라고 불렀어요. 승객 32명이 위독하지 않은 부상으로 병원에 옮겨졌고, 항만 경찰관 두 명도 입원했지만 상태가 좋았으며, 유조선 승선자는 다친 사람이 없었어요. 토요일 오후까지 여덟 명이 병원에 남았고 그중 두 명은 중상이었지만, 두 선박에 탄 모든 사람의 소재가 확인됐고 사망자는 보고되지 않았어요. 승선 인원은 출처마다 달랐어요. 시장은 승객과 승무원 191명, 항만 당국은 승객 약 129명과 승무원, 가디언은 승객 197명이라고 전했어요. 아메리칸 헤리티지는 2015년에 건조돼 아메리칸 크루즈 라인이 운항하는 5층 배로, 최대 150명을 태울 수 있고 루이지애나와 미시시피를 도는 8일 일정을 마무리하던 중이었어요.

paragraphs.en: Coast Guard Capt. Melanie Burnham, who commands the New Orleans sector, said the tanker appeared to have suffered some type of loss of steering, though she stressed the exact reason was unknown. The National Transportation Safety Board sent a go team on Saturday, recovered the tanker's voyage data recorder and appealed to the public for video and information. NTSB investigator John DeLeeuw said a preliminary report should be ready in about 30 days, while a final report with probable causes and safety recommendations could take 18 to 24 months. He said investigators may stay at least seven days, would begin interviews over the next two days and must first make the capsized riverboat safe before examining it. Moreno added that NTSB members arrived later than expected because a nationwide Federal Aviation Administration ground stop on Friday delayed and canceled thousands of flights.
paragraphs.ko: 뉴올리언스 구역을 지휘하는 해안경비대 멜라니 번햄 대령은 유조선이 어떤 형태의 조타 상실을 겪은 것으로 보이지만 정확한 이유는 모른다고 강조했어요. 국가교통안전위원회(NTSB)는 토요일 신속대응팀을 보내 유조선의 항해자료기록장치를 회수했고, 시민에게 영상과 정보를 요청했어요. NTSB의 존 드리우 조사관은 예비 보고서가 약 30일 뒤 나오고, 추정 원인과 안전 권고를 담은 최종 보고서는 18~24개월이 걸릴 수 있다고 말했어요. 그는 조사관들이 최소 7일 머물 수 있고, 앞으로 이틀 안에 면담을 시작하며, 뒤집힌 강배를 살피기 전에 먼저 안전부터 확보해야 한다고 했어요. 모레노 시장은 금요일 연방항공청의 전국 운항 중지로 수천 편이 지연·취소되어 NTSB 인력이 예상보다 늦게 도착했다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: Late Friday the Port of New Orleans's board of commissioners sued the tanker, its owner Nave Shipping SA and its manager Thome Ship Management in federal court in the Eastern District of Louisiana. The port seeks more than $1 million for damage to the terminal, plus cleanup, inspection and other costs, and warns that the sum could rise and further defendants could be added. It alleges negligence, gross negligence and failure to use all available means to avoid the collision, noting that fault is presumed when a ship strikes a stationary object. The port also asked that the tanker be seized and sold to cover the damage, and Judge Wendy Vitter approved the seizure on Friday. The complaint insists the port bears no responsibility for the crash. OSM Thome said the tanker's crew were safe, pledged full cooperation with the authorities and thanked responders for acting with urgency and humanity, while Nave Shipping did not immediately respond to CBS.
paragraphs.ko: 금요일 늦게 뉴올리언스 항만 위원회는 루이지애나 동부 연방법원에 유조선과 선주 네이브 시핑, 관리사 톰 십 매니지먼트를 상대로 소송을 냈어요. 항만은 터미널 피해로 100만 달러 넘는 배상과 정화, 점검 등 비용을 요구하며, 금액이 늘고 피고가 추가될 수 있다고 밝혔어요. 소장은 과실과 중과실, 충돌을 피할 모든 수단을 쓰지 않은 점을 주장하며, 선박이 정지한 물체를 들이받으면 과실이 추정된다고 짚었어요. 항만은 피해를 메우도록 유조선을 압류해 매각해 달라고도 요청했고, 웬디 비터 판사는 금요일에 압류를 승인했어요. 소장은 항만에는 이번 충돌의 책임이 없다고 주장해요. OSM 톰은 유조선 선원들이 무사하다며 당국에 전적으로 협조하겠다고 했고, 긴급하고 인간적으로 대응한 이들에게 감사를 전했어요. 네이브 시핑은 CBS에 즉시 답하지 않았어요.

paragraphs.en: Burnham said roughly 16,000 gallons of fuel remained aboard the American Heritage, making safe removal of hazardous material the top priority, and that salvaging the wreck could take weeks. The Atlantic Asphalt has been towed to another location, the crash site will remain a restricted area, and the Coast Guard, which closed the river at impact, is weighing how to reopen it. The tanker carries asphalt and bitumen, and the Associated Press, citing MarineTraffic, reported that its owner is a subsidiary of the state-owned China State Shipbuilding Corporation, which the BBC said it had contacted for comment. President Trump praised the Coast Guard and other agencies on Truth Social for doing an incredible job on the rescue.
paragraphs.ko: 번햄 대령은 아메리칸 헤리티지에 연료 약 1만 6천 갤런이 남아 있어 위험 물질의 안전한 제거가 최우선이며, 선체 인양에는 몇 주가 걸릴 수 있다고 했어요. 애틀랜틱 애스팰트는 다른 곳으로 예인됐고 사고 현장은 출입이 제한되며, 충돌 때 강을 닫았던 해안경비대는 재개방 방안을 검토하고 있어요. 이 유조선은 아스팔트와 역청을 나르며, AP는 마린트래픽을 인용해 선주가 국영 중국선박공업그룹의 자회사라고 전했고, BBC는 그 회사에 입장을 물었다고 했어요. 트럼프 대통령은 트루스소셜에서 해안경비대 등 기관이 구조에서 놀라운 일을 해냈다고 칭찬했어요.

views.view: The BBC reports the port blames the tanker for the crash, while the exact cause is under investigation and a loss of steering is suspected.
The Guardian stresses the first legal consequences, including the seizure order, and the NTSB timeline of a preliminary report in about 30 days.
CBS News details the rescue, witness accounts and the NTSB's recovery of the tanker's voyage data recorder.
CBS notes the port's suit says the tanker failed to use all available means to avoid hitting a stationary riverboat.
Moreno called the survival of everyone aboard a miracle on the Mississippi and praised first responders.

why: A river cruise ship capsized at a dock with about 130 to 200 people aboard, yet no one died, a rare outcome that investigators and courts will now dissect.
